limitations: The flux-zero jump is a discontinuity of the infinite-time expectation, not of finite-time evolution.
Half flux has zero capture probability; the mean is infinite.
No generalization is claimed for asymmetric or larger rings.
Independent scientific review and priority verification are not performed.
integrity.scientific_scope: One-excitation Peierls C4, opposite source and unique Lindblad sink; flux and sink rate arbitrary; no other loss or dephasing.

title: Zero-flux mean-capture discontinuity and optimal sink strength in a magnetic quantum square
